name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
changes.summary: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat. (Image credit: Drew Angerer).

changes.title: Democrats Lead Governor Races Deep in Republican Territory, Polls Show
changes.summary: Democratic advantages in the races for governor in Texas, Iowa, Ohio and Alaska reflect deep unhappiness with President Trump and the economy. A Republican leads in Kansas.

changes.title: Some Democrats Say Senate Race In South Carolina Is Winnable. Others, not so much.
changes.summary: Dr. Annie Andrews, a Democrat, is hoping to defeat Senator Darline Graham. Even some of her most ardent supporters sense that her bid is a long shot.

changes.title: CBS News poll finds Democrats maintain House advantage amid concern about prices
changes.summary: Here are 10 things to know about the 2026 midterm elections, in no particular order, based on what voters are telling us today.

changes.title: Rahm Emanuel says Democrats should focus on ethics reforms rather than impeaching Trump
changes.summary: Democrats have publicly weighed whether they should pursue impeaching Trump for a third time.

changes.title: Poll: Latino voters swing away from Trump and Republicans
changes.summary: Democrats have a significant lead among Latino voters in 2026 amid economic concerns, according to the NBC News/Telemundo poll.

changes.title: How Democrats Have Changed the Way They Talk About Trans Issues
changes.summary: Democrats competing in historically conservative territory in the midterms are more aggressively responding to Republican attacks casting them as extreme.
